'''Paul Todd Feldman Feldman's Sanctuary''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/sanctuary.html Feldman's Sanctuary!], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991022220609/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/sanctuary.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Clak'dor VII|ANH-L-clakdorvii.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Asteroid Sanctuary
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Feldman LS Sanctuary 1999 Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
An [[Asteroid Sanctuary]] deck that Feldman held back from World Finals. It uses [[Rebel Barrier]] and droids for [[Never Tell Me The Odds]]. The list has 63 cards, and "Cloud City Plaza" is listed as the site gives it.<ref name="torch" />
